name_input: TOUGH COLOR RESINS PRIVATE LIMITED; Tough Color Resins Private Limited
export_evidence: ImportKey page for slug 'tough-color-resins-private-limited' reports 'Total Shipments 60 Records detected' / 'Trading Partners 6' / 'Latest Cargo 2026-02-26', but every one of the 5 rows actually rendered is an inbound shipment into India, e.g. '2026-02-26 | SHANDONG TIANMAI CHEMICAL INDUSTRY CO., LTD -> TOUGH COLOR RESINS PRIVATE LIMITED | POLYESTER RESIN A1 | Qingdao, CHINA -> NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | HS 39079120 | BOL 7753933'. The company appears as BUYER/consignee in all visible rows; no outbound (India -> foreign destination) bill of lading with date, destination and HS code was seen. Source counter: page claims 60 records; rows actually seen = 5 (all import-side). Slug variants tried: 'tough-color-resins-private-limited' (60 records, 5 rows), 'tough-color-resins-pvt-ltd' (page loaded, zero rows rendered), 'tough-color-resins' (page loaded, zero rows rendered). volza.com/p/tough-color-resins/ and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403; trademo.com returned HTTP 403; DuckDuckGo search backend was unreachable ('Connection refused') for all queries, so no second source could be cross-checked.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender, contract award or annual-report split was found or readable. Search tooling was unavailable (searx 'Connection refused') and the trade-data mirrors that might carry GST/turnover context (volza, eximpedia, trademo) all returned HTTP 403. Nothing to quote; recorded as null rather than inferred.
note: Import-side activity is real and documented: the company is an active Indian importer of polyester resin (HS 39079120), polyvinyl alcohol (HS 39053000), neopentyl glycol (HS 29053990) and lab equipment (HS 90278990), with named suppliers (Shandong Tianmai Chemical, Chang Chun Petrochemical, White Way Shipping LLC, Kara Express FZE) and bill-of-lading numbers (7753933, 9144129, 6805029, 8212517, 8086153), latest record 2026-02-26. That confirms it is an operating chemical trader/processor, but it is NOT evidence of supply: no export shipments and no domestic supply trail were found. Declared HS 390799 (polyester, other) is close to but not identical to the observed import HS 39079120 (unsaturated polyester resin) — per project rules this is not a rejection ground; the company stays in the base and the actual code should be corrected to the observed 39079120/39053000/29053990 mix. Export volume and revenue: null (not public in any readable source). No rejection: legal entity appears active in customs records; no liquidation/bankruptcy evidence found. Caveat: single-source (ImportKey free view) only, second sources blocked — treat as 'следов поставок не найдено' pending a paid-data or GST check.
